title: Technology Sector Update for 12/17/2018: DCAR, SPI, CSIQ, MSFT, IBM, AAPL, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.50%
AAPL: -0.35%
IBM: -0.42%
CSCO: -0.37%
GOOG: -0.39%
Technology stocks were retreating in Monday's pre-bell trading.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) DropCar Inc. ( DCAR ), which was soaring more than 55% after unveiling a definitive deal to sell its WPCS International - Suisun City Inc. subsidiary, or Suisun Operations, to certain members of Suisun's existing management team for $3.5 million in cash.
(-) SPI Energy ( SPI ) was lower by more than 7% after announcing a notification from the Nasdaq Stock Market that it is not in compliance with the $15 million floating market capitalization requirement of the exchange.
In other sector news:
(=) Canadian Solar ( CSIQ ) was unchanged as it entered into a 10-year power purchase agreement with Germany's TrailStone GmbH for electricity produced by a portfolio of solar projects in Sicily.
